```{r}
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)

print(load(file.path(clinical.dir, "UpdatedClinical_Mar2026.RData")))
vars <- c(
  "AGE", "SEX", "TBMGRADE", "LTA4H",
  "CSFWBC", "CSFNEUTLE", "CSFLYMLE",
  "PROTEIN", "CSFGLUCRATIO",
  "outcome_2m", "outcome_12m",
  "arm"
)
bsl_clinic_26tb <- bsl_clinic_26tb %>%
  mutate(LTA4H = recode(LTA4H, "TC" = "CT")) %>% dplyr::rename(CSFGLUCRATIO = CSF_BL_GLUC) %>%
  left_join(Baseline_26TB %>% dplyr::select(USUBJID, outcome_2m, outcome_12m), by = "USUBJID")
bsl_clinic_27tb <- bsl_clinic_27tb %>% left_join(Baseline_27TB %>% dplyr::select(USUBJID, CSFGLUCRATIO, outcome_2m, outcome_12m), by = "USUBJID") %>%
  dplyr::rename(PROTEIN = CSFPROTEIN)
bsl_clinic_26tb$SEX <- factor(bsl_clinic_26tb$SEX, levels = c("M", "F"))
bsl_clinic_27tb$SEX <- factor(bsl_clinic_27tb$SEX, levels = c("M", "F"))
make_table1_strict <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    select(all_of(vars)) %>%
    tbl_summary(
      by = arm,
      type = list(
        AGE ~ "continuous",
        SEX ~ "dichotomous",
        TBMGRADE ~ "categorical",
        LTA4H ~ "categorical",
        CSFWBC ~ "continuous",
        CSFNEUTLE ~ "continuous",
        CSFLYMLE ~ "continuous",
        PROTEIN ~ "continuous",
        CSFGLUCRATIO ~ "continuous",
        outcome_2m ~ "dichotomous",
        outcome_12m ~ "dichotomous"
      ),
      value = list(
        SEX ~ "M",
        outcome_2m ~ "Deceased",
        outcome_12m ~ "Deceased"
      ),
      statistic = list(
        all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}–{p75})",
        all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
      ),
      digits = list(
      all_continuous() ~ c(2, 2), # e.g., 2 digits for mean and sd
      all_categorical() ~ c(0, 1) # e.g., 0 for counts, 1 for percentages),
      ),
      missing = "no",
      
      label = list(
        AGE ~ "Age, yrs",
        SEX ~ "Male, No. (%)",
        TBMGRADE ~ "Tuberculous meningitis grade (%)",
        LTA4H ~ "LTA4H genotype (%)",
        CSFWBC ~ "Total leukocytes, cells/μL",
        CSFNEUTLE ~ "Neutrophils, cells/μL",
        CSFLYMLE ~ "Lymphocytes, cells/μL",
        PROTEIN ~ "Protein level, g/L",
        CSFGLUCRATIO ~ "CSF:blood glucose ratio",
        outcome_2m ~ "2-month mortality, deceased, no. (%)",
        outcome_12m ~ "12-month mortality, deceased, no. (%)"
      )
    ) %>%
    
    add_p(
      test = list(
        all_continuous() ~ "wilcox.test",
        all_categorical() ~ "fisher.test"
      )
    ) %>%
    
    modify_table_body(
      ~ .x %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          p.value = ifelse(
            is.nan(as.numeric(p.value)),
            NA,
            p.value
          )
        )
    ) %>%
    add_overall() %>%
    add_variable_group_header(
      variables = c(
        "CSFWBC",
        "CSFNEUTLE",
        "CSFLYMLE",
        "PROTEIN",
        "CSFGLUCRATIO"
      ),
      header = "Cerebrospinal fluid features"
    ) %>%
    
    add_variable_group_header(
      variables = c("outcome_2m", "outcome_12m"),
      header = "Outcome"
    )
}
tbl_26TB <- make_table1_strict(bsl_clinic_26tb)
tbl_27TB <- make_table1_strict(bsl_clinic_27tb)
tbl_horizontal <- tbl_merge(
  tbls = list(tbl_27TB, tbl_26TB),
  tab_spanner = c(
    "**HIV-negative TBM**",
    "**HIV-positive TBM**"
  )
) %>%
  as_flex_table()

library(officer)
doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_end_section_landscape() %>%
  body_add_flextable(tbl_horizontal)

print(
  doc,
  target = paste0(
    output.dir,
    "/Table1.Patients_Characteristic.docx"
  )
)
```
